bic_trace_step.reason: In the function `bnge_rdma_aux_device_add` (lines 201-218), when `auxiliary_device_add(aux_dev)` fails, the code enters the `if (rc)` block, calls `auxiliary_device_uninit(aux_dev)`, and clears `BNGE_EN_ROCE` from `bd->flags`.
